summary.run_type: Weekly job sweep — city-led discovery checkpoint
summary.notes: Broad title-led city research covered all 14 registered Job Search cities and identified 17 discrete new leads across regional researchers; five were promoted after live official posting checks and scoring. Fourteen cities received discovery coverage, but no exhaustive company-by-company or mapped-pair ledger was completed. Three November deadlines were checked; Chevron expired and moved to Expired Roles. Wells Fargo and Aurora remain live. UNIGE MSc Commodity Trading was refreshed from official admissions/course pages. Source totals and regional researcher web-call counts were not surfaced, so no source/page volume is claimed.
summary.locations_covered: Hong Kong; New York; San Francisco; Singapore; Seoul; Tokyo; Shanghai; Beijing; Boston; London; Sydney; Vancouver; Zurich; Geneva
summary.masters_cities_covered: Geneva (targeted existing commodity-trading programme refresh only)
summary.companies_covered: Targeted pages: Modo Energy; IMC Trading; Trafigura; Chevron; Wells Fargo; Aurora Energy Research; enfinium. City-led researchers also checked additional postings; full 432-company inventory remains open.
summary.source_families: Public city/title search; employer careers pages and ATS (Greenhouse, Workday, Lever/official careers); official company vacancies; University of Geneva admissions and course-plan pages; ECB reference exchange rates; secondary listings used only as discovery leads
summary.codex_usage: not surfaced; regional researcher calls not reported
summary.coverage_gaps: Frozen brief: 432 active ranked companies, 982 mapped company-city pairs, 14 cities and 169 open roles. Broad city-led searches are complete as a first-pass layer (14/14), but employer-by-employer checks are not complete; no row-level completion ledger exists for the 432 companies or 982 pairs. Three of 169 pre-existing active roles with November deadlines were reviewed; the remaining role-status/deadline refresh is outstanding. Hong Kong/Singapore deep scan remains incomplete. Do not call this a completed weekly sweep.
summary.cadence_changes: None. Keep the weekly company/role sweep and monthly programme cadence. Maintain daily native-language search coverage in China, Japan and South Korea; basic Mandarin is not working proficiency.
summary.results_summary: Added Modo Energy Market Analyst, Modeling (CAISO/SPP), IMC Commodities Analyst – China and Commodities Trader – China (Sydney), Trafigura Crude Trader (Geneva), and enfinium Energy Analyst (London). Added enfinium to Company Registry at provisional rank 433; no street office was inferred. Moved Chevron Singapore Trading Analyst to Expired Roles after deadline plus employer-page 404. Updated UNIGE MSc in Commodity Trading with mandatory GRE/GMAT, GMAT 550 floor, 2027 application window and required Swiss industry traineeship. Several other leads remain pending or excluded with reasons in city-led-discovery.md.
